structured.answer: I'd go with Harel, the "מניות" track (קופה 8522). Harel is a name I know, it's at the top of the page, its fee is about the lowest on the page at 0.55% and it shows 24.04% for 3 years, where the S&P tracks show around 13%.

stuck.where: Screen 1, row of track buttons under 'במה הכסף מושקע'
stuck.why: There are 20 buttons and I didn't know which to press. I left it on 'הכול 143'.
Every company has the same tracks with the same layout. After Harel and Mor it all blurred, so I stopped around Phoenix, about halfway down.
Lots of tracks show no number at all, just this, including Altshuler S&P 500, which has the lowest fee. I couldn't compare them, so I left them out.
I came here for the S&P because my friends talk about it. But on the same screen the מניות track had 24% next to 13.7%, so I switched.

findings.what: 143 rows that all look the same. Every company repeats the same tracks, and every row repeats 'מניות / מט"ח', 'מהחיסכון / מההפקדות', '3 שנים / 5 שנים', so I kept rereading the same labels to find what was different. I'd have closed it on the bus around screen 5.
Lots of tracks have no return, just 'פחות מ־3 שנים', including the cheapest S&P (Altshuler 0.54%). I can't compare them, so I skipped them.
Fees are only in percents (0.55%, 0.56%…). The differences look like nothing, and there's no shekel amount for my money.
No recommendation and no 'start here', just a list. Too many options that look alike.
The ring chart with two colours and percentages that don't add up to 100 (94% and 25%) confused me.
20 filter buttons with words like 'עוקב מדדים - גמיש' and 'אג"ח ממשלתי' that mean nothing to me.
The second fee line, 'מההפקדות 0%', repeats on almost every row for nothing.
The orange '!' and 'עוד לא דווח' look like a warning, so I kept away from those rows.
findings.where: New tracks (Mor הלכה, Meitav אג"ח ממשלתי, Altshuler משולב סחיר)
